5.7.5.5 DataReceiveErrorEvent
Purpose:
Triggers a runnable entity used to “collect” the error status of a data
element with “data” semantics on the receiver side.
Signature:
[SWS_Rte_01359]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00072,
SRS_Rte_00029,
SRS_Rte_
00079
⌈
void <name>([IN Rte_Instance <instance>])
⌋
Notes:
The runnable entity triggered by a DataReceiveErrorEvent RTE-
Event should use the Rte_IStatus API to actually read the status.
